C-TABLE-FIT-PERSISTENCE.Name: Fit to page persists through the host profile
C-TABLE-FIT-PERSISTENCE.Summary: The native owner review of bae95a97 partially accepted C-TABLE-FOOTER but Fit to page never left Full width. The proven host-side gap: the renderer tableLayoutStore sanitizer dropped muya's fit flag, so an explicit «Fit to page» choice could not survive the save/reload path. Repair the sanitizer, pin the transition and the persistence in both engines, and leave the native same-frame confirmation to the fresh isolated artifact.
C-TABLE-FIT-PERSISTENCE.ApprovalBasis: Owner instruction 2026-10-20: do not widen C-TABLE-FOOTER (its visual scope is accepted); create a separate narrow follow-up C-TABLE-FIT-PERSISTENCE with a failing unit test first, a transition scenario, a persistence scenario, and conditional three-point instrumentation if the browser transition passes while native does not. The boundary is also contracted in docs/release-trains/2.5.x-next-followups.md EP-03.
C-TABLE-FIT-PERSISTENCE.ProblemEvidence: .grace/changes/active/C-TABLE-FOOTER/evidence.json diagnosticBoundary: «The renderer host tableLayoutStore sanitizer omits the Muya fit flag, so an explicit Fit to page choice cannot survive the host save/reload path even though Muya-local persistence tests pass»; src/renderer/src/util/tableLayoutStore.js sanitizeEntry kept only widths/manual/fullWidth. The native same-frame click failure is NOT yet attributed: it still needs the fresh-artifact confirmation this bundle hands forward.

Goals.Goal: { fit: true } survives sanitize → save → load (unit-pinned, failing before the repair).
Full width → Fit to page flips the mode and the toggle label in the same tick; the choice is written through mt::prefs::set with the fit flag.
Reopening the document re-adopts the stored fit: the wide table does not return to Full width and the label stays «Full width».

Constraints.Constraint: Full width wins a contradictory entry — the same rule muya's sanitizer applies.

No muya-side changes unless the native artifact proves a same-frame defect; if the browser transition passes and native fails, record the three state points (toolbar action received → Muya layout emitted → host payload saved) and repair only the proven segment.
The focused owner recheck covers only Fit: enable Full width, return to Fit to page, reopen the document — accepted footer/caption/counter scope is not reopened.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No C-TABLE-FOOTER visual changes, no new toolbar affordances, no scroll-ownership changes.
No release action; C-TABLE-FOOTER re-acceptance and queueing wait for the focused native recheck.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The failing-on-main unit cases pass: sanitize keeps fit (and drops it under fullWidth), and the save → load roundtrip restores the fit entry; the pre-existing suite passes on the extended schema.
The e2e proves the same-tick transition, the persisted fit flag in the prefs payload, and the reopened document staying in Fit in Chromium and WebKit.
grace lint --assertions current stays at zero errors; V-M-012 records the scenario and the evidence file names the native confirmation as the remaining step.

AffectedAreas.Area: src/renderer/src/util/tableLayoutStore.js (sanitizeEntry + contract v1.1.0); tests/renderer/store/table-layout-store.test.js (fit cases + schema extension); tests/e2e/table-layout.spec.ts (new case); .grace/verification V-M-012 scenario-72; graph M-012 summary line.

VerificationIntent.Command: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/e2e/table-layout.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit-tables
